analysis.mode: Saved evidence analysis; no engine import, fitting, simulation or numerical replay

audit_diagnostics.interpretation: An omitted-law pass is acceptance of an approximate finite candidate on the fixed diagnostic, not recovery of the true law; in-library rejection concerns the acquired fit, not impossibility of the model family.

caveats: Identical active/COUNTERFORM behavior in four saved instances cannot establish that the decision heuristic is generally ineffective; the policies were not behaviorally separated here.
Oracle gaps combine search approximation, grid restrictions and task mismatch; each challenge receives a retrospective oracle choice, not one attainable common oracle design.
The source reports DOP853/Radau discrepancy on the first selected-design challenge only; this analysis verifies the saved value's provenance, not a fresh integration.
Only the first held-out playback trajectory is saved; the remaining challenge RMS values are checked algebraically but not recomputed from trajectories.
Source equality and checksums establish consistency with saved metadata; coordinated edits could rewrite all checksums.
Fixed audit threshold .1 is an engineering diagnostic, not a calibrated model-class test, false-acceptance rate estimate or significance test.
The benchmark contains no linear or pure-friction world, uses only two parameter seeds, one noise level and one three-acquisition budget.
World-seed pairs share k,c,alpha and seeded noise conventions; 16 runs and 48 challenge evaluations are not 16 or 48 independent replicates.
The separate five-acquisition seed42 example is illustrative and excluded from the equal-budget benchmark.
All reductions are conditional on synthetic instrumented dynamics, the three fixed challenge protocols, finite 30-design grids and sampled 7-14 s RMS windows; no physical deployment claims follow.

design_diagnostics.grid_interpretation: All runs share a 30-entry combinatorial rule; physical stiffness and damping depend on fitted weighted stiffness. It is not an identical physical grid across strategies.

units_and_aggregation.oracle_definition: Retrospective minimum separately per challenge in that run's fitted-reference 30-design grid; unconstrained; oracle may use a different design at every challenge
units_and_aggregation.paired_delta_direction: COUNTERFORM minus comparator; positive reduction delta favors COUNTERFORM
units_and_aggregation.pooled_rms_formula: sqrt(mean(challenge_RMS**2)) over three equal-length 7-14 s sampled windows
units_and_aggregation.statistical_scope: Descriptive only; two shared parameter seeds, no confidence intervals, p-values or population efficacy claims
units_and_aggregation.world_strategy_mean_formula: arithmetic mean of two per-run pooled-RMS reductions; not pooled across seeds
